question: What is Florida's chronic liver disease mortality rate in 2022? (A) 21.5 per 100k (B) 24.0 per 100k (C) 17.3 per 100k. Answer with just the letter.
description: MT attack on the public_health bar chart. The y-axis starts just below the smallest bar instead of at 0, exaggerating differences. Misleader from Lo et al., 'Misinformed by Visualization' (EuroVis 2022): truncated axis. True answer: C (17.3 per 100k). Bait: A (21.5 per 100k).
